'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[2025 Gaza City offensive]]
****At least 91 [[Palestinians]] are killed by [[Israel]]i attacks across the [[Gaza Strip]], including 76 people in [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/9/20/israeli-bombing-kills-over-90-palestinians-as-gaza-city-faces-destruction (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***At least three people are killed and more than 30 people are injured in a [[Russia]]n [[drone warfare|drone]] and missile attack on critical infrastructure and [[residential building]]s across [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ce3253gxqvwo (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-hits-ukraine-with-barrage-drones-missiles-kills-3-kyiv-says-2025-09-20/ (Reuters)]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***Four people are killed and one person is injured in a Ukrainian drone attack on oil [[refineries]] in [[Novokuybyshevsk]], [[Samara Oblast]] and [[Saratov]], [[Saratov Oblast]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ce3253gxqvwo (BBC News)] [https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-reportedly-strike-oil-refinery-in-russia-saratov-oblast-explosions-reported-deep-inside-russia/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
*[[Druze insurgency in Southern Syria (2025–present)|Druze insurgency in Southern Syria]]
**Pro-government [[Bedouin]] tribes issue a 10 day ultimatum to [[Druze]] insurgents to release hostages held in the [[Suwayda Governorate]] under the threat of a resumption of hostilities. [https://www.syriahr.com/en/370136/ (SOHR)]
*[[Haitian conflict (2020–present)|Haitian conflict]]
**At least eight children are killed and six others are injured after explosive drones strike the birthday party of a suspected gang leader in [[Cité Soleil]], [[Port-au-Prince Arrondissement|Port-au-Prince]], [[Haiti]], with [[Human rights in Haiti|human rights]] groups accusing [[Haitian National Police|police]] of carrying out the attack that also leaves several adults dead. [https://apnews.com/article/haiti-drone-attack-cite-soleil-children-killed-339677efb2e5926b182f1934fafd6e5e (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least seven people, including five children, are killed and several others are injured when the roof of a private academy collapsed in [[Punjab, Pakistan|Punjab province]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://english.news.cn/asiapacific/20250920/452fe7fe2e6643cea93192a709442334/c.html (Xinhua)]
*Two people are killed, including television host Débora Estrella, when a [[Cessna 150]] crashes in [[García, Nuevo León|García]] [[Nuevo León]], Mexico. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/mexican-tv-host-debora-estrella-dies-in-plane-crash-during-flying-lesson-9326247 (NDTV)]
*Two [[Polish Special Forces]] soldiers die in the [[United States]] during night [[High-altitude military parachuting|parachute training]], according to the [[Poland|Polish]] [[Armed Forces General Command (Poland)|Armed Forces General Command]]. The [[GROM Military Unit]] reports that they were [[paratrooper]]s from the [[Silent Unseen|CICHOCIEMNI]] group. '''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Nashua shooting]]
**One person is killed and eight others are injured, including six non-gunshot victims, in a shooting at the Sky Meadow Country Club in [[Nashua, New Hampshire|Nashua]], [[New Hampshire]], United States. The suspect is arrested. [https://www.wmur.com/article/sky-meadow-country-club-nashua-new-hampshire-shooting/67982589 (WMUR-TV)]
*[[Collins Aerospace cyberattack]]
**A cyberattack on a service provider causes flight disruptions at multiple European airports. [https://www.dw.com/en/airports-across-europe-face-disruptions-due-to-cyberattack/a-74073365 (DW)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024–2025 French political crisis]]
** Between 500,000, according to French authorities, and one million people, according to the unions, manifest or participate in [[labour strike]]s across [[France]], to protest against [[austerity]] politics planned by [[President of France|President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]], and to pressure him to finally choose a [[Prime Minister of France|prime minister]] representative of the [[2024 French legislative election]] results. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20250918-anti-austerity-strikes-and-protests-rock-france-pressure-macron (France 24)]
*[[Ecuador]]'s [[National Electoral Council (Ecuador)|electoral council]] approves [[President of Ecuador|President]] [[Daniel Noboa]]'s request for a referendum on [[2008 Constitution of Ecuador|constitutional changes]], including ending the ban on foreign military bases and eliminating state funding for [[List of political parties in Ecuador|political parties]], while the [[Constitutional Court of Ecuador|Constitutional Court]] reviews challenges to his proposal for a [[constituent assembly]]. [https://apnews.com/article/ecuador-referendum-noboa-drugs-constitution-manta-ac43191767e191e44ca88d2d47fb3329 (AP)]
